sources.name: BDO
sources.grade_note: Flagged as broken, but the scraper was fine and the contract had to be corrected.

incidents.diagnosis: The scraper was not broken. BDO's listing mixes dated articles with evergreen podcast hubs, an eBook summary and an assessment tool, none of which carry a publication date. The contract had assumed every listed item is dated.
incidents.resolution: Contract corrected, not the scraper: partial date coverage is content, below 25% is a break. This is why the loop re-runs and re-validates rather than trusting a done status.

sources.name: Grant Thornton
sources.grade_note: Flagged as broken, but the scraper was fine and the contract had to be corrected.

incidents.resolution: Generation had completed server-side after the CLI stopped watching. The collector returns 20 clean rows and was nearly discarded. A client-side poll timeout is not evidence a collector is dead: run it before rebuilding.

fleet_incidents.trigger: Twelve firm URLs fed to a single collector built against RSM; eleven returned nothing.
fleet_incidents.diagnosis: Asked heal to rewrite the extraction to cover eleven unseen layouts generically.
fleet_incidents.resolution: heal ran for 40 minutes through code_fixer and returned status: error. Scraper Studio generates extraction code against a specific site and heal repairs a collector against its own target; it will not port one to unrelated domains. The collector was left untouched, which is how we learned heal is non-destructive. Architecture changed to one collector per layout.

fleet_incidents.trigger: Seven of thirteen sources reported 'Crawler error: Navigation failed ... too many'.
fleet_incidents.diagnosis: Read as broken selectors, the contract named five healthy firms in a heal prompt.
fleet_incidents.resolution: Not a scraper problem: three orphaned fleet runs were racing each other, so Marcum was being scraped by four concurrent jobs. Running a collector is rate limited at the crawler, separately from the AI-Flow generation cap. Concurrency reduced to 2, and the contract taught to separate a failed run from a break so heal is never dispatched at one.
